title: VoiceBBQ: Investigating Effect of Content and Acoustics in Social Bias of Spoken Language Model
findings: All tested models (LLaMA-Omni, Qwen2-Audio, and their backbones LLaMA 3.1 and Qwen1) exhibited bias in the 'Religion' category. LLaMA-Omni generally showed lower bias scores for religion compared to its backbone and the Qwen models. Acoustic features of the speaker's voice (gender and accent) did not cause statistically significant variations in model responses for the religion category.
